findings.text: non-blocking: the `if not family` and `else` branches of the message at 785-799 cannot be reached, and the else branch states a rule the store does not implement. A refusal fires only when record_for_review_run_anywhere found no record matching the requested rubric; because _review_rubric_matches (reckon/crew/review.py:2753) classifies every non-figure record as the text family for rubric=None, any record this reader would report under an empty or third family would already have been returned as named_record, so only the figure branch at 790 is live. The else text also claims "which a disposition does not select" for a named family, while _review_rubric_matches would let --rubric <that family> select a non-figure record. It is dead code asserting a behaviour the selection does not have, and it would mislead whoever makes a third family selectable.
